 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Bayern Munich host Magdeburg at the Allianz Arena in the second round of the German Cup, with Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or dominating the conversation even though he won't be starting today.
 Here are the line-ups for today's game in Munich:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bayern : Neuer, Stanisic, Tah, Ito, Brown; Bischof, Laimer; Karl, Olise, Gnabry – and Saibari.
 Magdeburg : Reimann – Nadjombe, Müller, Garcia MacNulty, Nollenberger – Hyryläinen, Chavez, Musel – Iyoha, Zukowski, Atik.
